entry_state: Product/geographic margins permit different conditional exposures. Subsidiary membership does not determine ownership paths,sellers,tax residence or functional currency. Legal proceedings retain remedy,jurisdiction,status and separate information dates; operating consequences need contract facts. Later disclosures may reveal an earlier cost without changing the economic history; the adoption-plan comparison begins next.
exit_state: Later segment expenses refine a source-content view without proving historic public availability or changing transactions. Indemnity,defense,settlement and insurance remain distinct channels. Regulation can constrain feasible operations; demand loss,supply interruption and recovery require separate facts and dates. The historical record must preserve issuer assertions and conditional operating assumptions separately.

findings.observation: The Americas2024 bridge uses expense detail from the later2025 source while preserving the original2024 claim. Equal corporate amounts do not equate differently described categories. January clarification timing and exact-version availability prevent a period-end-only information query.

Indemnity direction,defense cost and possible insurance recovery each have distinct missing terms. Purchased insurance is not an insurer issued-contract measurement task; the qualified interim risk incorporation does not assert identical policies or balances.

The import-delay mechanism requires dates,legal scope,affected products and feasible responses. Two explicit operating histories distinguish weak demand from unavailable components. Ending an interruption is separated from restored capacity,deliveries and recovery spending.
